title: Locking Dance Choreography Tutorial for Beginners - Online Dance Class at Home

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher is very encouraging and uses a friendly, upbeat tone to keep the student motivated. She breaks down complex movements into simple, manageable steps and frequently repeats them to ensure the student understands.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces herself and the dance style.
The teacher explains the characteristics of locking.
The teacher breaks down the first movement.
The teacher breaks down the second movement.
The teacher breaks down the third movement.
The teacher breaks down the fourth movement.
The teacher combines all the movements together.
The teacher turns around to show the movements from the back.
The teacher practices the choreography with music.

common_mistakes: The teacher mentions that the student might try to move both legs, but only one is needed.
safety: The teacher advises consulting a doctor before starting the exercises.

steps_taught.name: Muscle lock
steps_taught.description: Cross arms in front of the upper body and bring them up.

steps_taught.name: Locking with the hands
steps_taught.description: Bend the left knee and shift the hip to the right side.

steps_taught.name: Uncle Sam
steps_taught.description: Left arm goes down, right hand comes to the left shoulder, and point to the sky.

what_works: The teacher breaks down the movements into small, easy-to-follow steps.
The teacher uses clear, simple language and provides helpful cues.
The teacher repeats the movements multiple times to help the student learn.
what_hinders: The teacher's pace might be a bit fast for some beginners.
The teacher does not provide enough time for the student to practice each movement before moving on to the next one.

quotes.text: Locking relies on fast and distinct arm and hand movements.
I will mirror these movements for you.
As if you want to show your bicep muscles.
Uncle Sam is always pointing up to the sky.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher displays a disclaimer on the screen.
The teacher demonstrates the muscle lock movement.
The teacher demonstrates the locking with the hands movement.
The teacher demonstrates the Uncle Sam movement.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses a mirror-image approach, which makes it easier for the student to follow along.
